comparison_variable: measured stop position relative to source-identified nearest track
fixed_conditions: same at-grade crossing, official stop sign and dangerous-crossing designation
same driver and vehicle body extent, route, camera policy and approach occluder
same controller policy except requested centre stop station
native_source_requirements: original map and nearest-track approach edge with rail geometry hash
official sign governance and dangerous-crossing designation authority records
original vehicle centre, body extent and observed speed on 600 joined Native frames
original occluder geometry and observed rail approach visibility
original train state when present or explicit none-observed/unknown state
four named source-camera streams with complete frame joins

source_observation_terms_mapped.rel.centre_distance: front, centre and rear feet from nearest track at observed stop
source_observation_terms_mapped.drv.stopped: observed Native speed history and source-linked cessation interval
source_observation_terms_mapped.drv.time_to_conflict: not used as a due-care cutoff; train state and visibility retained for review
source_observation_terms_mapped.ru.rail_vehicle: observed train state retained when present; presence not required for activation
